article.title: What instruments may be partially cancelled.
article.content: Where an instrument is evidence of different rights or different obligations, the court may, in a proper case, cancel it in part and allow it to stand for the residue.
article.html:
32What instruments may be partially cancelled.

Section 32 · Part II · Chapter V · page 13 of the Act

Where an instrument is evidence of different rights or different obligations, the court may, in a proper case, cancel it in part and allow it to stand for the residue.
